findings.title: Timeout assertion is vague and sits in the wrong test
findings.body: `expect(exec.mock.lastCall?.[2].timeout).toBeGreaterThan(34_000)` is the only check on the new POST timeout. It passes for any value above 34s, so it does not pin the 120_000 in `frontend/src/main/github-issue-artifact.ts:19`. It also runs inside the `it.each` named 'returns the original issue when GitHub may have stored the upload', which says nothing about timeouts. Assert `toBe(120_000)` for the POST, ideally in its own test. A GET case at 30_000 would show that only uploads get the longer limit.
